```{r quiz-data-gen, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# Generate JSON from targets pipeline data and embed in script tag
safe_tar_read <- function(name) {
  store <- Sys.getenv("TARGETS_STORE", unset = NA)
  if (is.na(store)) {
    store <- tryCatch(
      file.path(rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::is_r_package), "_targets"),
      error = function(e) "_targets"
    )
  }
  tryCatch(targets::tar_read_raw(name, store = store),
           error = function(e) NULL)
}
pairs <- safe_tar_read("vig_quiz_pairs")
if (is.null(pairs)) {
  pairs <- rbind(
    micromort::quiz_pairs(difficulty = "easy", seed = 42),
    micromort::quiz_pairs(difficulty = "medium", seed = 42),
    micromort::quiz_pairs(difficulty = "hard", seed = 42)
  )
}
json_str <- jsonlite::toJSON(pairs, dataframe = "rows", auto_unbox = TRUE)
cat(sprintf('<script id="quiz-data" type="application/json">%s</script>', json_str))
```

```{=html}

<script>
// ---- State ----
const S = {
  phase: 'instructions', nQuestions: 5, currentQ: 0,
  pairs: [], answers: [], displayOrder: [], revealed: [],
  selDifficulty: 'mixed', selNq: 5, seenKeys: new Set()
};
let quizPool = [];

// ---- Data ----
function loadData() {
  const el = document.getElementById('quiz-data');
  if (!el) return;
  quizPool = JSON.parse(el.textContent);
}

// ---- Helpers ----
function shuffle(arr) {
  const a = [...arr];
  for (let i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    [a[i], a[j]] = [a[j], a[i]];
  }
  return a;
}
function formatName(name) { return name.replace(/\s*\(/, '<br>('); }
function fmtMM(v) {
  if (v >= 100) return Math.round(v).toLocaleString();
  if (v >= 1) return parseFloat(v.toFixed(1)).toString();
  if (v >= 0.01) return parseFloat(v.toFixed(2)).toString();
  return parseFloat(v.toFixed(3)).toString();
}
function renderQR(containerId, size) {
  const url = window.location.href.split('?')[0].split('#')[0];
  const el = document.getElementById(containerId);
  if (!el || typeof qrcode === 'undefined') return;
  const qr = qrcode(0, 'M');
  qr.addData(url);
  qr.make();
  el.innerHTML = `<div class="qr-section">
    ${qr.createImgTag(size || 3)}
    <span class="qr-url">${url}</span>
  </div>`;
}
function selectInGroup(grpId, clicked) {
  const btns = document.getElementById(grpId).querySelectorAll('.option-btn');
  btns.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('selected'));
  clicked.classList.add('selected');
}

// ---- Leaderboard (pure JS, same as before) ----
const FORM_URL = 'https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc1HX5kPVO6G982zOxH2BLv1FWexiITPnbjfWMN3a1M9yDtvw/formResponse';
const SHEET_URL = 'https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/17HLtIdV3r55dIh06cSaWT8kFXzNrkR-Fu2ZJkjszG8k/gviz/tq?tqx=out:json';
const STATS_URL = 'https://johngavin.github.io/micromort/api/quiz_stats.json';
let scoreSubmitted = false;

function resetLeaderboard() {
  scoreSubmitted = false;
  const btn = document.getElementById('submit_btn');
  if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Submit Score'; btn.className = 'btn btn-warning btn-lg'; }
  const el = document.getElementById('percentile_text');
  if (el) el.textContent = '';
}

function submitScore(score, total, difficulty, nQuestions) {
  if (scoreSubmitted) return;
  const btn = document.getElementById('submit_btn');
  if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Submitting...'; btn.className = 'btn btn-secondary btn-lg'; }
  const data = new URLSearchParams();
  data.append('entry.335579146', score);
  data.append('entry.2122920576', total);
  data.append('entry.621716914', new Date().toISOString());
  data.append('entry.268026248', 'acute');
  data.append('entry.232879816', difficulty || '');
  data.append('entry.2010782223', nQuestions || '');
  fetch(FORM_URL, {method: 'POST', mode: 'no-cors', body: data}).then(() => {
    scoreSubmitted = true;
    if (btn) { btn.textContent = 'Submitted!'; btn.className = 'btn btn-success btn-lg'; }
    getPercentile(score, total, difficulty, nQuestions);
  }).catch(() => {
    scoreSubmitted = true;
    if (btn) { btn.textContent = 'Score saved locally'; btn.className = 'btn btn-info btn-lg'; }
  });
}

function interpolatePercentile(scorePct, group) {
  const p = group.percentiles, s = group.scores_pct;
  for (let i = s.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { if (scorePct >= s[i]) return p[i]; }
  return 0;
}

function getPercentile(score, total, difficulty, nQuestions) {
  const pct = score / total * 100;
  fetch(STATS_URL).then(r => { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(); return r.json(); })
  .then(stats => {
    const d = stats.acute;
    let msg = 'You scored better than ' + interpolatePercentile(pct, d.overall) + '% of all players';
    const key = (difficulty || 'mixed') + '_' + (nQuestions || 5);
    const sub = d.by_config[key];
    if (sub && sub.n >= 10) msg += ' (' + interpolatePercentile(pct, sub) + '% of ' + difficulty + '/' + nQuestions + 'Q players)';
    msg += '! (' + d.overall.n + ' submissions)';
    const el = document.getElementById('percentile_text');
    if (el) el.textContent = msg;
  }).catch(() => {
    // Fallback to live Sheet
    const el = document.getElementById('percentile_text');
    if (el) el.textContent = 'Loading rankings...';
    fetch(SHEET_URL).then(r => r.text()).then(text => {
      const json = JSON.parse(text.replace(/.*google\.visualization\.Query\.setResponse\(/, '').replace(/\);$/, ''));
      let below = 0;
      json.table.rows.forEach(row => {
        const s = row.c[0] ? row.c[0].v : 0, t = row.c[1] ? row.c[1].v : 10;
        if ((s / t * 100) < pct) below++;
      });
      const percentile = json.table.rows.length > 0 ? Math.round(below / json.table.rows.length * 100) : 50;
      if (el) el.textContent = 'You scored better than ' + percentile + '% of players! (' + json.table.rows.length + ' submissions)';
    }).catch(() => { if (el) el.textContent = 'Score submitted! Rankings unavailable right now.'; });
  });
}

// ---- Result phrases ----
const PHRASES = [
  {min: 95, phrase: 'Actuarial genius!', fact: 'Actuaries quantify risk for a living.', link: 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Actuary'},
  {min: 90, phrase: 'You think in micromorts!', fact: 'A micromort is a one-in-a-million chance of death.', link: 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Micromort'},
  {min: 80, phrase: 'Sharp intuition!', fact: 'Humans tend to overestimate dramatic risks and underestimate common ones.', link: 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Risk_perception'},
  {min: 70, phrase: 'Better than a coin toss!', fact: 'We judge risk by how easily examples come to mind.', link: 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Availability_heuristic'},
  {min: 60, phrase: 'Getting there!', fact: 'Losses loom larger than gains in our risk calculus.', link: 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prospect_theory'},
  {min: 50, phrase: 'About average!', fact: 'Ignoring base rates is one of the most common reasoning errors.', link: 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Base_rate_fallacy'},
  {min: 30, phrase: 'Surprises everywhere!', fact: 'We tend to assume things will keep going as normal.', link: 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Normalcy_bias'},
  {min: -1, phrase: 'Toss a coin — less risky!', fact: "Past outcomes don't change future probabilities.", link: 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gambler%27s_fallacy'}
];
function getPhrase(pct) { return PHRASES.find(p => pct >= p.min) || PHRASES[PHRASES.length - 1]; }

const ENCOURAGEMENTS = [
  "Go on, your inner actuary is dying to play. (Not literally.)",
  "Warning: may cause sudden urge to recalculate your commute.",
  "Spoiler: everything is riskier than you think.",
  "No micromorts were harmed in the making of this quiz.",
  "Side effects may include newfound respect for seatbelts.",
  "Think you know risk? Prove it.",
  "Your overconfidence is showing. Let's test it.",
  "Statistically, you'll enjoy this. Probably."
];

// ---- Render functions ----
function render() {
  const app = document.getElementById('quiz-app');
  switch (S.phase) {
    case 'instructions': app.innerHTML = renderInstructions(); renderQR('qr-instructions', 4); break;
    case 'question': app.innerHTML = renderQuestion(); break;
    case 'results_summary': app.innerHTML = renderResults(); renderQR('qr-results', 5); break;
    case 'results_detail': app.innerHTML = renderDetail(); break;
  }
}

function renderInstructions() {
  const enc = ENCOURAGEMENTS[Math.floor(Math.random() * ENCOURAGEMENTS.length)];
  return `
    <div class="card"><div class="card-body">
      <ul class="mb-1">
        <li>Each question shows <b><em>two risky activities</em></b>.</li>
        <li>Tap the activity that you think is <b><em>riskier</em></b>.</li>
        <li>You can <b><em>skip</em></b> questions or go <b><em>back</em></b> and review previous answers.</li>
        <li>Skipped (unanswered) questions score zero.</li>
        <li>A <b><em>micromort (mm)</em></b> is a one-in-a-million chance of death.</li>
      </ul>
      <div class="mb-1" style="padding-left:1.5em;"><em>${enc}</em></div>
      <div class="option-row">
        <span class="option-label">Difficulty</span>
        <div class="option-btn-group" id="grp_diff">
          <button class="option-btn" onclick="S.selDifficulty='easy';selectInGroup('grp_diff',this)">Easy</button>
          <button class="option-btn" onclick="S.selDifficulty='medium';selectInGroup('grp_diff',this)">Medium</button>
          <button class="option-btn" onclick="S.selDifficulty='hard';selectInGroup('grp_diff',this)">Hard</button>
          <button class="option-btn selected" onclick="S.selDifficulty='mixed';selectInGroup('grp_diff',this)">Mixed</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="option-row">
        <span class="option-label">Questions</span>
        <div class="option-btn-group" id="grp_nq">
          <button class="option-btn selected" onclick="S.selNq=5;selectInGroup('grp_nq',this)">5</button>
          <button class="option-btn" onclick="S.selNq=10;selectInGroup('grp_nq',this)">10</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="text-center mt-3">
        <button class="btn btn-primary btn-lg" onclick="startQuiz()">Start Quiz</button>
      </div>
      <div id="qr-instructions"></div>
    </div></div>`;
}

function startQuiz() {
  let pool = S.selDifficulty !== 'mixed'
    ? quizPool.filter(p => p.difficulty === S.selDifficulty)
    : [...quizPool];

  // Exclude seen pairs
  pool = pool.filter(p => {
    const key = [p.activity_a, p.activity_b].sort().join('|||');
    return !S.seenKeys.has(key);
  });
  if (pool.length < S.selNq) { S.seenKeys.clear(); pool = S.selDifficulty !== 'mixed' ? quizPool.filter(p => p.difficulty === S.selDifficulty) : [...quizPool]; }

  const n = Math.min(S.selNq, pool.length);
  S.nQuestions = n;
  S.pairs = shuffle(pool).slice(0, n);
  S.pairs.forEach(p => S.seenKeys.add([p.activity_a, p.activity_b].sort().join('|||')));
  S.answers = new Array(n).fill(null);
  S.displayOrder = S.pairs.map(() => Math.random() < 0.5 ? ['a','b'] : ['b','a']);
  S.revealed = new Array(n).fill(false);
  S.currentQ = 0;
  S.phase = 'question';
  render();
}

function renderQuestion() {
  const q = S.currentQ, n = S.nQuestions, pair = S.pairs[q];
  const ord = S.displayOrder[q], revealed = S.revealed[q], answer = S.answers[q];
  const L = ord[0], R = ord[1];

  function side(s) {
    return {
      activity: pair['activity_' + s], category: pair['category_' + s],
      mm: pair['micromorts_' + s], period: pair['period_' + s],
      desc: pair['description_' + s], help: pair['help_url_' + s]
    };
  }
  const left = side(L), right = side(R);

  function btnClass(s, isRiskier) {
    if (!revealed) return 'quiz-btn';
    if (isRiskier) return 'quiz-btn quiz-btn-correct';
    if (answer === s) return 'quiz-btn quiz-btn-wrong';
    return 'quiz-btn quiz-btn-neutral';
  }
  const leftRiskier = left.mm > right.mm, rightRiskier = right.mm > left.mm;

  function btnContent(d, s, cls) {
    const mmText = revealed ? `<strong style="font-size:1.4rem;color:#333;">${fmtMM(d.mm)} mm</strong>` : '';
    const helpLink = d.help ? `<a class="help-link" href="${d.help}" target="_blank" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">Learn more →</a>` : '';
    const clickAttr = revealed ? '' : `onclick="choose('${s}')"`;
    return `<div class="${cls}" ${clickAttr}>
      <span class="activity-name">${formatName(d.activity)}</span>
      <div><span class="badge bg-secondary me-1">${d.category}</span><span class="badge bg-info">${d.period}</span></div>
      ${mmText}${helpLink}
    </div>`;
  }

  // Result text
  let resultHtml = '';
  if (revealed) {
    const correct = pair.answer;
    const userCorrect = answer === correct;
    if (answer === null) {
      resultHtml = `<div class="alert alert-danger text-center mt-2 py-2">Skipped! ${pair['activity_' + correct]} is riskier.</div>`;
    } else if (userCorrect) {
      resultHtml = `<div class="alert alert-success text-center mt-2 py-2"><strong>Correct!</strong></div>`;
    } else {
      resultHtml = `<div class="alert alert-danger text-center mt-2 py-2"><strong>Incorrect!</strong> ${pair['activity_' + correct]} is riskier.</div>`;
    }
    // Explanation
    const riskier = pair.answer, safer = riskier === 'a' ? 'b' : 'a';
    resultHtml += `<div class="explanation-panel mt-2">
      <p><strong>${pair['activity_' + riskier]}</strong> has ${fmtMM(pair['micromorts_' + riskier])} mm: ${pair['description_' + riskier] || ''}</p>
      <p><strong>${pair['activity_' + safer]}</strong> has ${fmtMM(pair['micromorts_' + safer])} mm: ${pair['description_' + safer] || ''}</p>
      <p>${pair['activity_' + riskier]} is ${pair.ratio.toFixed(1)}x riskier than ${pair['activity_' + safer]}.</p>
    </div>`;
  }

  // Tally
  let correctSoFar = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i <= q; i++) { if (S.answers[i] !== null && S.answers[i] === S.pairs[i].answer) correctSoFar++; }
  const answered = S.revealed.filter(Boolean).length;

  const diffBadge = pair.difficulty ? `<span class="badge bg-${pair.difficulty === 'easy' ? 'success' : pair.difficulty === 'medium' ? 'warning' : 'danger'} me-2">${pair.difficulty}</span>` : '';

  return `
    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-3">
      <button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="prevQ()">← Back</button>
      <span class="text-muted">${diffBadge}${q+1} of ${n} · <small>Score: ${correctSoFar}/${answered} correct</small></span>
      <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="nextQ()">${q === n-1 ? 'Finish' : 'Next →'}</button>
    </div>
    <div class="quiz-row">
      <div class="quiz-col">${btnContent(left, L, btnClass(L, L === pair.answer))}</div>
      <div class="quiz-vs"><h3 class="text-muted mb-0">VS</h3></div>
      <div class="quiz-col">${btnContent(right, R, btnClass(R, R === pair.answer))}</div>
    </div>
    ${resultHtml}`;
}

function choose(side) {
  S.answers[S.currentQ] = side;
  S.revealed[S.currentQ] = true;
  render();
}
function nextQ() {
  if (S.currentQ < S.nQuestions - 1) { S.currentQ++; render(); }
  else { S.phase = 'results_summary'; render(); }
}
function prevQ() {
  if (S.currentQ > 0) { S.currentQ--; render(); }
  else { S.phase = 'instructions'; render(); }
}

function renderResults() {
  const n = S.nQuestions;
  let score = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { if (S.answers[i] !== null && S.answers[i] === S.pairs[i].answer) score++; }
  const pct = score / n * 100, baseline = (n / 2).toFixed(1);
  const info = getPhrase(pct);

  return `
    <h2 class="text-center mb-4">Results</h2>
    <div style="display:flex;gap:16px;margin-bottom:1rem;">
      <div style="flex:1;"><div class="card text-white bg-primary"><div class="card-body text-center">
        <small>Your Score</small><h2 class="mb-0">${score} / ${n}</h2>
      </div></div></div>
      <div style="flex:1;"><div class="card text-white bg-secondary"><div class="card-body text-center">
        <small>Random Guessing</small><h2 class="mb-0">~${baseline} / ${n}</h2>
      </div></div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="text-center mb-4">
      <h3>${info.phrase}</h3>
      <em>${info.fact}</em><br>
      <a href="${info.link}" target="_blank">Learn more →</a>
    </div>
    <div class="d-flex justify-content-center gap-3">
      <button id="submit_btn" class="btn btn-warning btn-lg" onclick="submitScore(${score},${n},'${S.selDifficulty}',${S.selNq})">Submit Score</button>
      <button id="share_btn" class="btn btn-success btn-lg" onclick="shareResult(${score},${n})">Share</button>
      <button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-lg" onclick="S.phase='results_detail';render()">View Details</button>
      <button class="btn btn-primary btn-lg" onclick="resetLeaderboard();S.phase='instructions';render()">Try Again</button>
    </div>
    <div class="text-center mt-2">
      <small id="percentile_text" class="text-muted"></small><br>
      <small class="text-muted">Scores are recorded anonymously (score, total, timestamp only).</small>
    </div>
    <div id="qr-results"></div>`;
}

function shareResult(score, n) {
  const pEl = document.getElementById('percentile_text');
  const pLine = pEl && pEl.textContent ? '\n' + pEl.textContent + '\n' : '\n';
  const text = '☠️ Micromort Quiz: I scored ' + score + '/' + n + '!' + pLine +
    'Which lifestyle event is more likely to kill you?\n' +
    'Can you beat my score? ☠️\n' +
    'https://johngavin.github.io/micromort/articles/micromort-quiz.html';
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => {
    const btn = document.getElementById('share_btn');
    btn.textContent = 'Copied!';
    setTimeout(() => { btn.textContent = 'Share'; }, 2000);
  });
}

function renderDetail() {
  const n = S.nQuestions;
  let rows = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const p = S.pairs[i], ans = S.answers[i];
    const userAns = ans === null ? 'Skipped' : p['activity_' + ans];
    const correctAns = p['activity_' + p.answer];
    const result = ans === null ? '—' : (ans === p.answer ? '✓' : '✗');
    const linkA = p.help_url_a ? `<a href="${p.help_url_a}" target="_blank">${p.activity_a}</a>` : p.activity_a;
    const linkB = p.help_url_b ? `<a href="${p.help_url_b}" target="_blank">${p.activity_b}</a>` : p.activity_b;
    rows += `<tr><td>${i+1}</td><td>${linkA}</td><td>${fmtMM(p.micromorts_a)}</td>
      <td>${linkB}</td><td>${fmtMM(p.micromorts_b)}</td>
      <td>${userAns}</td><td>${correctAns}</td><td>${result}</td></tr>`;
  }
  return `
    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-4">
      <button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="S.phase='results_summary';render()">← Back to Results</button>
      <h3 class="mb-0">Your quiz details</h3>
      <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="resetLeaderboard();S.phase='instructions';render()">Try Again</button>
    </div>
    <div class="detail-scroll">
      <table class="table table-striped table-hover detail-table">
        <thead><tr><th>Q</th><th>Activity A</th><th>mm A</th><th>Activity B</th><th>mm B</th><th>Your Answer</th><th>Correct</th><th>Result</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>${rows}</tbody>
      </table>
    </div>`;
}

// ---- Init ----
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  loadData();
  render();
});
</script>
```
